title: Split pre-fill and validation must match the server to the cent

acceptance_criteria.outcome: Web pre-filled Exact and Percentage values add up exactly to the total or 100, with each leftover hundredth on a different randomly chosen member.
Web and mobile accept an exact, percentage or payer total only when it matches to the cent; floating-point noise is tolerated.
Saving pre-filled values works for a new group expense, an edit and a move to a group, and stored shares add up to the total.

No minus value is accepted for money or splits: the server refuses negative split values and group receipt item values and never stores or drops a negative share; web and mobile number fields ignore a typed minus; saved settings from before the rule still load.

notes: Implementation authorized by the owner in conversation on 2026-11-26 ('...randomly assign one person with a cent more... can you apply this fix?').
